Sample.evidence_source: Twelve participants were included in the analysis.

Type.evidence_source: This study employed a generic (inductive) qualitative approach with a focus on human experiences.24 Twelve participants were included in the analysis. The purposive sampling provided a homogenous group of the size considered optimal to the generic qualitative approach.17 The 5 steps for conducting thematic analysis as by Braun and Clark25 were followed: familiarizing with the data (each individual transcript was read and reread highlighting ideas for codes/themes); initial codes were generated and organized into meaningful groups; different codes were sorted into potential themes and collated to establish relationships between codes, themes and different subgroups of themes; themes were reviewed to ensure distinctions between themes were clear; and themes were defined and named to determine clearly what aspect of the data was captured by each theme. Initial procedures were carried out by the first author (LK).
